human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Make every OpenGap finding auditable from measured signal to representative OpenAIRE records. Evidence must be visibly distinct from interpretation, and a zero project match must be represented as a scan result rather than a fabricated record. Depends on: 0001.result-semantics-freeze, 0002.signal-engine-hardening.
human_pressure.why_now: The hackathon value proposition depends on OpenAIRE-backed evidence; without an inspectable chain the product can be mistaken for generic AI summarization.
do_not_misread: This is a hackathon freeze pack: improve credibility and demo reliability without widening the product surface.
Repository-specific file paths and validation commands must be mapped from the actual OpenGap repository before execution.
A measured imbalance is a signal, not proof of a scientific research gap.
red_lines: Do not fabricate placeholder evidence records.
Do not expose API tokens, credentials, or raw secret-bearing payloads.
Do not imply sampled records alone prove the aggregate count.
Do not replace valid external record URLs with synthetic routes unless the existing architecture already proxies them safely.

machine_core.goal: Expose a minimal, typed, source-linked evidence chain for each result: measured signals, why it was flagged, representative OpenAIRE records, and scan provenance.
red_lines: Do not fabricate placeholder evidence records.
Do not expose API tokens, credentials, or raw secret-bearing payloads.
Do not imply sampled records alone prove the aggregate count.
Do not replace valid external record URLs with synthetic routes unless the existing architecture already proxies them safely.
invariants: Evidence and interpretation are separate concepts in the result model.
Every evidence record has an entity type, title, source, and openable URL.
Zero project matches are represented as a count/provenance fact, not as a fake project entry.
Any and-N-more count is derived accurately and never negative.
Dependency 0001.result-semantics-freeze must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
Dependency 0002.signal-engine-hardening must already be accepted before this pack is accepted.
contracts: Supported evidence entity types are publication, project, software, and dataset.
Source for these evidence records is OpenAIRE.
Minimal provenance retains topic, source, and collection time when available.
A result must expose the measured signals that caused the classifier to flag it.
failure_semantics: Malformed or unsafe record URLs are omitted or rendered non-clickable instead of emitted as links.
Unknown year or metadata is omitted rather than rendered as undefined/null text.
Duplicate evidence records are suppressed by stable identifier or URL where practical.

steps.title: Map current evidence model and renderer
details: Locate evidence normalization, record type information, external links, and result list rendering.
Preserve currently working OpenAIRE record links.

steps.title: Type evidence records
details: Ensure each item carries publication/project/software/dataset type, title, source, URL, and optional year.
Avoid leaking raw response objects into presentation.

steps.title: Group visible evidence
details: Group representative evidence by entity type or research/funded activity.
For zero project matches show 0 directly matching project records found in this scan.

steps.title: Add minimal provenance
details: Retain normalized topic, OpenAIRE source, and collectedAt when available.
Expose a compact Measured from OpenAIRE records for this topic scan explanation.

steps.title: Harden counts and links
details: Ensure any remaining-count indicator is mathematically correct.

acceptance: Every flagged result visibly shows the measured counts that support the finding.
Evidence records are typed and open to their actual source records.
Zero project matches render as a scan result rather than fabricated evidence.
Interpretation and evidence are visibly distinguishable.
No secret-bearing API payload is exposed.

must_check: Finding -> measured signals -> why flagged -> OpenAIRE record links is inspectable.
Zero-project handling contains no fabricated record.
Record URLs are safe and openable.
Provenance is present without leaking secrets.
reject_if: A finding is shown with no visible measured evidence.
A placeholder or fake evidence record is created.
A raw secret or token appears in UI, logs, or generated evidence output.
Evidence type does not match the underlying record.
The implementation fabricates OpenAIRE counts, records, links, trends, or gap evidence.
The implementation expands the frozen MVP taxonomy beyond funding gap, reuse gap, and no strong structural gap.
The implementation weakens validation or changes validation commands merely to obtain a passing result.
The implementation modifies files outside the repository-mapped minimal scope for this pack.
The implementation introduces unrelated architecture or feature work.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Exact OpenGap test framework and concrete test files are not present in the conversation. Before execution, map package scripts and existing focused/component/e2e tests, then select the narrowest existing targets that protect this pack plus the repository normal full validation command where appropriate.
validation_notes.completion_reason: OpenGap repository paths and exact validation targets were not supplied; repository mapping is required before execution.

completion_constraints: Inspect the actual OpenGap repository before filling file scope or commands.
Map only existing files that directly implement the behavior described by this pack.
New test files may be added only when the existing test layout clearly supports them and they are listed in machine_core.files.create.
Use exact runnable commands from the repository; no shell globs and no invented scripts.
After completion, perform a deterministic schema and scope recheck before coder execution.
